_source: Read out of the running Blockly editor on https://jwinf.de/task/1668 (Freie Turtle-Umgebung) via Blockly.mainWorkspace on 2026-09-11. Paths are the `d` attribute of each block's svgPath_, sizes from getHeightWidth(), positions relative to the root block. Text widths are the editor's own (11pt sans-serif) and are only used here to explain the numbers.

robot_start.note: no hat: START_HAT is off. Rounded top-left, square right corners, no top notch; body 24 high.

moveamountvalue.note: single row with fields only: body 25. Fields start at x=10, 10 between them; a field box is text+10 wide, 16 high, at y=5.

moveamount.note: empty inline socket: a 14.5 wide, 26 high hole with the tab notch on its left; the row is 35 high.

controls_repeat_ext.note: statementEdge = 10 + 'mache'(44.02) + 10 = 64; mouth ceiling notch at edge+15..edge+30; foot is 10 high and only edge+30 wide; empty mouth 9 + two 8px arcs = 25 high; children start at edge+1, header+1.

controls_if.note: single value input → EXTERNAL socket cut into the right edge (v 5, tab, v 4 = 24 row); header 25.

controls_if_else.note: else arm: 10 high, then a second mouth; 'sonst' label 35.05 wide sits in the same 64 edge.

logic_negate.note: value block: all corners square, output tab on the left from y=5 to 20, external socket on the right.

math_number.note: value block width = 10 + box(text+10) + 10 = text + 30; height 25; getHeightWidth adds the 8px tab to width.

math_arithmetic.note: value block with inline inputs: row 36; first socket at x=17 (SEP + tab - 1); fields on an inline row sit at y=10.

colour_rgb.note: three external value inputs → three rows of 26, sockets on the right edge, all rows as wide as the widest.

procedures_defnoreturn.note: no arm label: statementEdge = 20, so the mouth notch sits at 35..50; no top notch, no bottom notch.

controls_flow_statements.note: cap block: no bottom notch, bottom-left still rounded.

program._xml: repeat(4){ moveamountvalue(3); if (1==2) {turneitheramountvalue 90 links} else {peneither penup} }

stack_in_mouth.note: first block in a stack keeps its rounded top-left; with a next block below, the bottom-left is SQUARE (H 0 z).

if_child.note: external child sits at parent x + parent width + 1, its tab reaching 8px into the parent's socket; the header row grows to the child's height (v 16 → 36).

highlights._source: svgPathLight_ of the same blocks, read out of https://jwinf.de/task/1668 on 2026-09-12. The light line follows the top edge with its notch, glints at the foot of every tab, runs along the floor of each mouth and up the left edge; nothing on the right or bottom edges. DISTANCE_45_INSIDE = (1 - 1/sqrt 2) * (r - 0.5) + 0.5 = 2.6967, DISTANCE_45_OUTSIDE = (1 - 1/sqrt 2) * (r + 0.5) - 0.5 = 1.9896.

variables_set.note: external input: top edge to rightEdge-0.5, a glint at (rightEdge-5, 19.3), then the rounded bottom-left corner and the left edge up to y=8.

math_number.note: value block: top edge, then from the bottom-left corner up the left edge with a curve along the back of the tab.

controls_repeat_ext_filled.note: inline socket: right wall and floor of the cut-out plus a glint at its tab; mouth: the inner bottom-left corner and the floor out to rightEdge-0.5. Mouth row height 30 for a 25-high child (child bbox = body + 1 shadow + 4 notch).

controls_if_else.note: one statement edge for both mouths (the wider label, falls, decides), and the arm under each mouth runs out to the block's full right edge.

colours_by_task.note: Standard categories are coloured per task. The robot training tasks (e.g. /task/1848) use schleifen #2fb5bd, logik #81b31d, mathe #3950a5, sensoren #2b7ca5, aktionen #723ca5, start #4789cc, which is what the jwinf profile follows. The Freie Turtle-Umgebung (/task/1668) uses schleifen #47cccc, logik #73cc47, mathe #475dcc, schildkroete #7347cc instead; variablen #a5416b, farben #cc7347 and funktionen #9911a5 are the same in both.

icons.note: Icons sit in the first row at translate(10,5), 16x16, group opacity 0.6, shape fill #00f stroke #fff, symbol #fff; the text after an icon starts at x=37 (10 + 16 + 1 + 10). controls_if: mutator gear. procedures_defnoreturn: mutator gear at 10 and a '?' comment icon (circle r8) at 37, the name field at 64. controls_flow_statements: warning sign when the block is not inside a loop (inside a wiederhole mouth it has none; inside a falls mouth it has one).
